path.id: Identifying the vicious reinforcing loops in the system.
Missing reports overlook neighborhoods, widening gaps in services.
Unresolved complaints discourage reporting, letting problems grow.
Feeling unsafe drives people away, isolating others.
Unreliable buses push commuters to private vehicles, worsening congestion.
Uncollected waste normalizes neglect and encourages littering.
When can a small change interrupt a recurring problem?
